revision.text: {{Wireless adapter |brand=Panasonic |model=N5HBZ000109 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=09/10/2013 |manuf_country=China |manuf=Wistron NeWeb |manuf_model=DNUA-P75 |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male Mini-B |form_factor= |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=NKR-P75 |ic_id=4441A-P75 |chip1_brand=Qualcomm Atheros |chip1_model=QCA9375X |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |accessible_UART=Yes |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:0B:6B |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} Per the FCC photos... *"48DNUA50.SGE" and "2013/08/05" is silkscreened on the bottom of the board. **The following is silkscreened on the antennas.. ***"48DNUA51.SGF" and "2013/08/16" (#1) ***"48DNUA52.SGE" and "2013/08/05" (#2) *This device is using QCA9375X-AL3D. *UART test pads are accessible on the bottom of the board. *The device is using (at least) a 00:0B:6B OUI.
